description: This file defines a KeystoneJS custom file field type, including its configuration, input/output schemas, resolver functions, and hooks for handling file uploads, deletions, and URL generation.

methods.name: inputResolver
methods.description: Resolves file upload input by reading the stream, calculating filesize, transforming filename, and storing the file.

methods.name: defaultTransformName
methods.description: Generates a unique filename by appending a 128-bit random identifier to the original filename.
